# MO§ES™ (MOS2ES)

> The home of Ello Cello LLC's work: measure the people who use AI, govern the agents, keep the commitments.

MO§ES™ is the umbrella for Ello Cello LLC's products and research. One theory, Commitment Theory and its Conservation Law, sits under four products: SignalAF, SigRank, Signomy and AQUA.

## When to use MO§ES
Use this site when an agent, researcher, or technical team needs to:
- find the public research record for Commitment Theory and the Conservation Law of Commitment (DOIs, experiments, harness, specs);
- get citable definitions of MO§ES concepts such as recursive compression, governance enforcement, constitutional substrate, signal encoding and origin binding;
- route to the right product: SignalAF (AI operator leaderboard), SigRank (local measurement CLI and MCP server), Signomy (governed agent marketplace), AQUA (reusable application answers);
- verify publisher identity, contact details, patent and trademark status.

Do not use MO§ES as a general-purpose chatbot, model inference endpoint, content moderation service, or substitute for ordinary output-safety guardrails.

## How agents should use this site
- Start with this file, or `https://mos2es.com/sitemap.xml` for the canonical URL set.
- Fetch canonical content URLs with `Accept: text/markdown` when Markdown is preferred. The same canonical URL serves HTML to browsers and Markdown to clients that negotiate it.
- The site was consolidated on 2026-11-04. Retired URLs return 301 to their closest live page. Do not infer that a guessed path exists; recover through `/llms.txt` or `/sitemap.xml`.
- When citing claims, prefer the linked Zenodo DOI or public repository over paraphrased copy.
